abilities.name: natural-cure
abilities.effect: Cures any major status ailment upon switching out.

abilities.name: serene-grace
abilities.effect: Doubles the chance of moves' extra effects occurring.

abilities.name: healer
abilities.effect: Has a 30% chance of curing each adjacent ally of any major status ailment after each turn.

original-johto.flavorText: Biting into one of the delicious eggs that BLISSEY provides will make everyone around smile with joy.

hoenn.flavorText: If it senses sadness with its fluffy fur, a BLISSEY will rush over to the sad person, however far away, to share an egg of happiness that brings a smile to any face.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: It is a Pokémon that delivers happiness. Eating its egg is said to make one kind to everyone.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: The eggs it lays are filled with happiness. Eating even one bite will bring a smile to anyone.

updated-johto.flavorText: It has a very compassionate nature. If it sees a sick Pokémon, it will nurse the sufferer back to health.

original-unova.flavorText: The eggs it lays are filled with happiness. Eating even one bite will bring a smile to anyone.

updated-unova.flavorText: The eggs it lays are filled with happiness. Eating even one bite will bring a smile to anyone.

kalos.flavorText: This kindhearted Pokémon nurses sick Pokémon to health. It senses feelings of sadness.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: Blissey senses sadness with its fluffy coat of fur. If it does so, this Pokémon will rush over to a sad person, no matter how far away, to share a Lucky Egg that brings a smile to any face.

original-alola.flavorText: Its fluffy fur coat acts as a sensor, enabling it to read the feelings of people and Pokémon.

updated-alola.flavorText: This Pokémon is overflowing with love. Only Chansey that share a strong bond with their Trainer can evolve, so people say.

swsh.flavorText: Blissey lays mysterious eggs that are filled with happiness. It’s said that anyone who eats a Blissey egg will start acting kindly to all others.

pla.flavorText: A kindhearted Pokémon that will care for any sick person or Pokémon until their health improves. The eggs it lays are delicious and bring good fortune to those who eat them.
